items.titleEn: Arteta issues fitness update on David Raya
items.summaryEn: Our goalkeeper was forced off with injury in our 2-2 draw at Newcastle
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has issued an update on David Raya after our no.1 was forced off with injury in our draw with Newcastle United on Saturday night.
The boss reported that David seems to have avoided a serious injury, but will be out for Tuesday's UEFA Champions League clash with Borussia Dortmund.
"He's not fit for tomorrow unfortunately," Mikel told reporters at the Sobha Realty Training Centre, "but it doesn't look too serious. We need some more tests tomorrow, but it's quite encouraging.

"With the pain that he was showing immediately after the action, we were all quite worried, but he seems to be better than we expected. When you look at the action, it doesn't seem to be much on it, but the extent of the pain that he had and how he was struggling, it was quite worrying."
While the exact extent of the injury remains to be seen, Mikel reported that the initial fears have somewhat subsided since Saturday's game.
Further tests will be carried out in order to determine how long David will be absent, but the boss admitted he was pleased that his compatriot seems to have avoided a long-term absence.

"Yes, as I mentioned, we expected something much worse because he could almost not handle the amount of pain that he had. The first test that we've done showed something that is much more encouraging.
"There's no need of surgery, which was the main fear especially because that would rule him out for month's, so let's see. Tomorrow, we'll have more tests and we will know."
The boss admits that missing someone of David's talent would affect any team, but has full confidence in the goalkeepers available to us tomorrow.
Both Kepa and Illan Meslier have played for us in cup competitions this season, and the boss is confident in having either goalkeeper between the sticks.
"We know, and I think we've seen what David brings to the team, but as well that's why we are very protective with Kepa and Illan.
"Everybody needs to be ready because these things unfortunately happen, and no we need to show how well we are protected and the good keepers we have with Kepa and Illan.
"We always assess every situation to make the right call and it's quite clear what we're going to do."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔更新大卫·拉亚的身体情况
items.summaryZh: 我们的门将拉亚在对阵纽卡斯尔的比赛中因伤离场，将缺席对阵多特蒙德的欧冠比赛。
bodyZh: 在周六晚阿森纳对阵纽卡斯尔联的比赛中，主力门将大卫·拉亚因伤离场，主帅米克尔·阿尔特塔随后更新了他的伤情。
主帅表示，大卫的伤势似乎并不严重，但他将缺席周二对阵多特蒙德的欧冠比赛。
米克尔在索布哈地产训练中心对记者们说道：“很遗憾他明天无法上场，但这看起来不是太严重。我们明天需要做更多检查，但目前情况相当令人鼓舞。”
“考虑到他受伤后立即表现出的痛苦，我们当时都很担心，但他的情况似乎比我们预期的要好。当你回看那个动作时，似乎并没有发生太多碰撞，但由于他当时感到的痛苦程度以及他当时的挣扎，这确实相当令人担忧。”
虽然伤势的确切严重程度还有待观察，但米克尔表示，自周六的比赛以来，最初的担忧已经有所缓解。
我们将进行进一步检查以确定大卫将缺席多久，但主帅承认，他很高兴这位同胞似乎避开了长期缺阵的伤病。
“是的，正如我所提到的，我们原本预计情况会更糟，因为他当时几乎无法忍受那种疼痛。我们做完的第一项检查显示的结果要鼓舞人心得多。”
“不需要进行手术，这是我们主要的担忧，特别是手术会让他在几个月内无法上场，所以我们拭目以待。明天我们将进行更多的检查，届时就会知道了。”
主帅承认，缺少像大卫这样有天赋的球员会对任何球队产生影响，但他对明天的可用门将充满信心。
凯帕和伊兰·梅斯利尔本赛季都曾代表球队参加过杯赛，主帅对这两位门将中的任何一位守门都充满信心。
“我们知道，而且我认为大家也看到了大卫为球队带来的贡献，但这也是我们非常保护凯帕和伊兰的原因。”
“每个人都需要做好准备，因为这些事情不幸会发生，现在我们需要展现出我们有很好的保护措施，并且通过凯帕和伊兰拥优秀的门将。”
“我们总是评估每一种情况以做出正确的决定，而且我们接下来要做什么非常明确。”

items.titleEn: Bruno feels his best is yet to come as a Gunner
items.summaryEn: Our summer signing has loved life in London so far, but feels he has another level
bodyEn: Bruno Guimaraes has had a successful start to life as an Arsenal player, helping us to the top of the Premier League and an unbeaten league phase in the UEFA Champions League.
But ahead of Tuesday's clash with Bundesliga leaders Borussia Dortmund, Bruno emphasised that he has another level to go to, and isn't satisfied with his performances in red and white just yet.

"Definitely I'm building up," Bruno told the media on Monday, "of course because I scored two goals, I think some fans want me to score every game, but it's not like this, I'm definitely adapting myself.

"I've been here three or four months, and there's still a lot to go. But now I definitely understand my role in the team, the way Mikel wants me to play in the team, so I think I still can play much, much better.
"The welcome has been amazing, I think [our supporters] have been so good with me, I want to thank them for their support."
Bruno has been with us for just under four months since joining from Newcastle United in the summer, and has become an instant fan-favourite.
But maintaining such a high performance level hasn't been easy, with the demands of thriving in our midfield pushing the Brazilian more than he's been pushed before in his career.
"It's very different, here is a little bit more free. You play as a six, an eight, and a nine sometimes, so we have to move a lot, and of course I was not used to it.

"Now I understand a little bit more what [Mikel Arteta' wants from the midfield. I understand Declan because it's a little hard, but yeah, I think now I'm getting there. I'm still not at the level that I want, but I feel I can play much more and help the team."
With the standard as high as it is in our squad, Bruno, like everyone else, has to play for his place.

Our No. 39 has started plenty of matches this season as well as featuring from the bench, and feels the competitive edge in the squad is a key factor in pushing everyone to perform at their highest level.

"We push each other to always be playing well, because if you don't play well, other players will come and play well; I think that's very important for Arsenal. We want to make a dynasty here; we want to win everything possible. I think since I came to the club, the first thing Mikel said to me was create a dynasty for the club, so we want to win everything that's possible.

"I know how much the Champions League means for the fans, and for us here. Tomorrow we have a big test with a top team, they have been unbelievable this season, so tomorrow we have to play a very good game because it's going to be against a top side."

Playing in such a competitive midfield has been a real highlights of the season so far for Bruno, with the likes of Martin Odegaard and Declan Rice to learn from. As well as their quality on the pitch, the Brazilian has been impressed with their mentality around the training ground and in the dressing room.
"They're both amazing players. I think Declan is a monster, he can run 15 kilometres in a game, and Martin Odegaard, he always can find space to penetrate the opposite side.
"I'm learning a lot with the guys, they're trying to help me where I have to position myself when we don't have the ball, when we do have the ball, and like I said, it's about adaptation.
"But I think so far it has been good. The mentality is unbelievable, we don't play for a draw here, we play for a win every game, that's the level.
"It's what Mikel demands for us and his staff every day, so the mentality is very good. I think we are creating something big here, and I hope at the end of the season we can celebrate together."

items.titleZh: 布鲁诺表示自己作为阿森纳球员还有更大潜力
items.summaryZh: 夏季新援适应伦敦生活，并表示未来能展现出更高水平。
bodyZh: 布鲁诺-吉马良斯在阿森纳度过了成功的开局，帮助球队登顶英超积分榜，并在欧洲冠军联赛小组赛中保持不败。
但在周二对阵德甲领头羊多特蒙德的比赛前，布鲁诺强调自己还有更高的上升空间，对目前身披红白战袍的表现并不完全满足。
周一接受媒体采访时，布鲁诺表示：“当然我正在不断进步，因为我进了两个球，我想有些球迷希望我每场比赛都进球，但事实并非如此，我肯定还在适应阶段。”
“我来这里已经三四个月了，还有很长的路要走。但现在我完全理解了我在球队中的角色，以及米克尔希望我在场上的踢法，所以我认为我还能踢得更好得多。”
“这里的欢迎仪式太棒了，我认为（我们的球迷）对我都很好，我想感谢他们的支持。”
自从夏天从纽卡斯尔联加盟以来，布鲁诺来到我们这里还不到四个月，就已经迅速成为了球迷的宠儿。
但要保持如此高的水平并不容易，在中场立足的高要求对这位巴西球员的挑战超过了他职业生涯以往的任何时候。
“这非常不同，这里自由度更高一点。有时候你得踢6号位、8号位甚至9号位，所以我们必须大量跑动，当然我以前很不习惯这一点。”
“现在我更多地理解了（米克尔-阿尔特塔）对中场的要求。我理解德克兰（赖斯），因为这有点困难，但是的，我想我现在快适应了。我还没达到我想要的水平，但我感觉我能发挥更大作用并帮助球队。”
由于我们阵容的标准极高，布鲁诺和所有人一样，必须为自己的主力位置而战。
我们的39号球员本赛季首发了多场比赛，也曾替补登场，他认为队内的竞争意识是推动每个人发挥出最高水平的关键因素。
“我们互相鞭策以保持良好状态，因为如果你表现不好，其他球员就会顶替上来并表现出色；我认为这对阿森纳非常重要。我们想在这里建立一个王朝；我们想赢得一切可能的荣誉。我想自我来到俱乐部以来，米克尔对我说第一句话就是要为俱乐部创造一个王朝，所以我们想赢得一切可能的荣誉。”
“我知道欧冠对球迷和我们意味着什么。明天我们将迎来一场对阵顶级球队的大考，他们本赛季表现极其出色，所以明天我们必须踢出一场精彩的比赛，因为对手是一支顶级强队。”
能在如此有竞争力的中场踢球是布鲁诺本赛季迄今为止的亮点之一，他可以向马丁-厄德高和德克兰-赖斯等人学习。除了他们在球场上的实力，这位巴西球员对他们在训练基地和更衣室展现出的心态也印象深刻。
“他们都是出色的球员。我认为德克兰是个野兽，他在比赛中能跑15公里，而马丁-厄德高总能找到空间去撕破对手防线。”
“我从大伙身上学到了很多，他们试图在我无球跑动和有球时帮我找到合适的位置，就像我说的，这关乎适应。”
“但我觉得目前为止一切都很好。这里的精神面貌令人难以置信，我们在这里不为平局而战，每场比赛都为胜利而战，这就是标准。”
“这也是米克尔和他的教练团队每天对我们的要求，所以球队的心态非常好。我认为我们正在这里创造伟大的成就，我希望在赛季结束时我们能一起庆祝。”

items.titleEn: Arteta on Dortmund, Madueke and Bellingham
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is all too familiar with the threat Borussia Dortmund pose as we host the Bundesliga leaders in the Champions League at Emirates Stadium.
The German side picked up a 3-2 win in N5 during pre-season and have carried that form into their campaign, losing just once across all competitions to top their domestic league.
Ahead of entertaining Dortmund once again, Mikel praised manager Niko Kovac and how they've started the 2026/27 campaign.

He said: "Very impressed with them, you see the results so far, where they are in the Bundesliga at the top and where they are in the Champions League and especially the way they are playing, the way they are dominating games, the amount of threat they are able to create.

"We had them here in pre-season, and they showed the quality and what they are capable of, so we are very much aware of that. But we play at home in front of our crowd, and now we’re going to go and attack the game, that’s for sure.

"There's a reason why they are the top in the Bundesliga and they have won the number of games that they've done in the Champions League and again in the manner that they've done it. So we know that we play a top side tomorrow and we are ready for it."
We could come up against two brothers in the space of three weeks, with Jobe Bellingham playing for Dortmund and his brother, Jude, representing Real Madrid when they visit on December 9.

On facing the Bellinghams, Mikel said: "I think you have to congratulate mum and dad for what he's done because it's incredible. I want you to look at the two of them and you put a different shirt on and it's incredible. Two amazing footballers; what they're doing is remarkable. So yeah, let's give credit to the parents!"
One player in fine form this season is Noni Madueke. The winger has been a constant threat all season, picking up six goal involvements already.
Mikel has seen an evolution in Noni and is thrilled with how he is stepping up, both on and off the pitch.
He said: "He’s becoming decisive in games, and that’s what we need from our front players. He’s done it in various ways, which is something that I really like.

"He has added variety and much more connection within his games, rather than almost relying on one-to-one actions. I love his intensity as well without the ball, so he’s becoming a much more complete player I would say and I think he’s enjoying it a lot.

"When you see his personality outside the pitch, he is a player that is so good at connecting with people and constantly talking and kidding and doing things, and now he is doing that in a serious way on the pitch, which is, in my opinion, really powerful.

"First of all because it keeps him connected and focused and I think that is going to translate on him having better actions and more volume of action which ultimately is going to give him the chance to decide games in my opinion."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈多特蒙德、马杜埃凯与贝林厄姆
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将在主场迎战多特蒙德，阿尔特塔出席赛前发布会。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔对多特蒙德所构成的威胁再熟悉不过了，接下来我们将在酋长球场迎来这场欧冠对决，对手是目前德甲积分榜的领头羊。
这家德国球队在季前赛时就曾在北伦敦以3比2取胜，并将这种良好状态延续到了新赛季中，各项赛事中仅输过一场，目前领跑国内联赛。
在再次迎战多特蒙德之前，米克尔称赞了主教练尼科·科瓦奇以及他们开启2026/27赛季的方式。
他说：“我对他们印象非常深刻，看看他们目前的战绩、他们在德甲的榜首位置以及他们在欧冠中的表现，尤其是他们的踢球方式、控制比赛的方式以及他们能够制造的威胁。”
“我们在季前赛时就交过手，他们展现出了实力和能力，对此我们非常清楚。但我们在主场作战，在球迷面前，我们肯定会全力出击。”
“他们排在德甲榜首、在欧冠中赢得那么多场比赛都是有原因的，而且他们赢球的方式也是如此。所以我们知道明天将面对一支顶尖球队，我们已经准备好了。”
我们可能在三周内先后面对两兄弟，乔布·贝林厄姆效力于多特蒙德，而他的哥哥裘德·贝林厄姆则将在12月9日随皇家马德里造访。
在谈到面对贝林厄姆兄弟时，米克尔说：“我认为你必须祝贺他们的父母，因为这太不可思议了。我想你看他俩穿着不同的球衣，这感觉太棒了。两个杰出的足球运动员，他们所做的事情非同寻常。所以，让我们向他们的父母致敬吧！”
本赛季状态正佳的一名球员是马杜埃凯。这位边锋整个赛季都保持着持续的威胁，已经贡献了6个进球或助攻。
米克尔看到了马杜埃凯的进化，对他无论在场上还是场下挺身而出的表现感到非常欣喜。
他说：“他正在比赛中变得具有决定性，这正是我们对前场球员的要求。他通过各种方式做到了这一点，这正是我非常喜欢的。”
“他的比赛变得更加丰富多样、联系更加紧密，而不仅仅是依靠一对一的突破。我也非常喜欢他在无球时的强度，所以我想他正在成为一名更加全面的球员，而且我认为他非常享受这一切。”
“当你看到他在场外的性格时，他是一个非常善于与人交流、不断开玩笑和做各种事情的球员，而现在他正在球场上以一种严肃的方式做到这一点，在我看来，这真的非常有力量。”
“首先是因为这能让他保持连结和专注，我认为这将转化为他更好的表现和更多次数的行动，这最终将使他有机会决定比赛。”

items.titleEn: Emirates Stadium named as potential 2035 World Cup venue
items.summaryEn: Emirates Stadium is one of 22 stadia named as candidates to host matches at the 2035 Women's World Cup after the UK won the bid to host
bodyEn: Emirates Stadium has been selected as a candidate stadium for the 2035 Women’s World Cup, following the news that the United Kingdom will host the finals for the first time.
FIFA confirmed that the UK will stage the 12th edition of the biggest tournament in women’s football, having bid unopposed to stage the competition in nine years’ time.

It will be the second Women’s World Cup to feature 48 teams, with the 2031 edition held across Mexico, the United States, Costa Rica, and Jamaica also set to do so. The tournament would involve 104 matches over 39 days across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, who all automatically qualify as co-hosts.
As part of the UK bid, a host of stadia across the country put themselves forward to host matches during the 48-team tournament, including our home.

These include five in London - Wembley, Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, Stamford Bridge, Selhurst Park and our Emirates Stadium, two in Birmingham - Villa Park and Birmingham City’s proposed Powerhouse Stadium, the Principality Stadium and the Cardiff City Stadium in the Welsh capital, plus the Etihad Stadium and Old Trafford in Manchester.

Two venues in Scotland have also put themselves forward: Hampden Park in Glasgow and Hibernian’s Easter Road in Edinburgh, while Windsor Park in Belfast is Northern Ireland’s selection. The Racecourse Ground in Wrexham adds further Welsh representation.

The rest of the contenders are the Amex Stadium in Brighton, Bristol City’s Ashton Gate, Elland Road in Leeds, Nottingham Forest’s City Ground, and Everton’s new Hill Dickinson Stadium venue, plus there is north-east representation in Newcastle United’s St James’ Park and Sunderland’s Stadium of Light.

items.titleZh: 酋长球场被列为2035年世界杯潜在举办场地
items.summaryZh: 英国成功申办2035年女足世界杯，酋长球场成为22个候选球场之一。
bodyZh: 在英国首次赢得女足世界杯决赛圈主办权后，酋长球场已被选为2035年女足世界杯的候选球场。
国际足联确认英国将举办第12届女足世界最大规模的赛事，此前英国在无竞争对手的情况下申办了9年后的这项比赛。
这将是第二届扩军至48支球队的女足世界杯，2031年由墨西哥、美国、哥斯达黎加和牙买加联合举办的赛事也将如此。该赛事将在英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰进行，历时39天共进行104场比赛，作为共同主办方，四支球队将直接获得参赛资格。
作为英国申办计划的一部分，全国各地的许多体育场都报名承办这届48支球队参加的赛事，其中包括我们的主场。
其中包括伦敦的五座球场——温布利球场、托特纳姆热刺球场、斯坦福桥球场、塞尔赫斯特公园球场以及我们的酋长球场，伯明翰的两座球场——维拉公园球场和伯明翰城市队提议的动力球场，威尔士首都的千禧球场和加的夫城球场，以及曼彻斯特的伊蒂哈德球场和老特拉福德球场。
苏格兰也有两座场馆报名：格拉斯哥的汉普顿公园球场和爱丁堡希伯尼安的复活节路球场，而贝尔法斯特的温莎公园球场则是北爱尔兰的入选球场。雷克赛姆的跑马场球场增添了更多威尔士的代表性。
其余的竞争者包括布赖顿的美国运通球场、布里斯托尔城的阿斯顿加门球场、利兹的埃兰路球场、诺丁汉森林的城市球场、埃弗顿的新希尔迪金森球场球场，以及纽卡斯尔联队的圣詹姆斯公园球场和桑德兰的光明球场等东北部代表场地。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is hopeful the ­shoulder injury David Raya sustained at Newcastle is not too serious, but confirmed the goalkeeper would miss Tuesday’s Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund.

Raya was forced off in the ­second half of Saturday’s 2-2 draw with a ­suspected dislocated shoulder, ­raising fears he could be sidelined for an extended period. He had an MRI scan on Arsenal’s return to London and was absent from ­training on Monday. Kepa Arrizabalaga is expected to deputise at home to Dortmund.

“He’s not fit for tomorrow, ­unfortunately, but it doesn’t look too serious,” the manager said. “With the pain he was showing immediately after the action we were all quite ­worried, but he seems to be better than what we expected. There’s no need of surgery, which was the main fear.”

Asked whether Raya could play at home to Manchester City on ­Sunday, Arteta said: “Tomorrow we’ll have more tests and we will know. I think we’ve seen what David brings to the team. That’s why we are very ­protective with Kepa and [third-choice] Illan [Meslier]. Everybody needs to be ready because these things happen.”

Dortmund are a point behind Arsenal in the Champions League after three wins from their first four matches and Niko Kovac’s side lead Bayern Munich by two points at the top of the Bundesliga. Arteta said a youthful side expected to feature Jobe Bellingham – who was called up by England for the first time for the most recent international break alongside his brother, Jude – would provide a real test.

“You have to congratulate mum and dad for what they’ve done,” Arteta said of the Bellingham ­brothers. “Two amazing ­footballers, what they’re doing is ­remarkable. So let’s give credit as well to the parents.”

items.titleEn: Every word from Mikel Arteta's pre-Dortmund presser
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta has been speaking to the press ahead of our home match against Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has been facing the media before we take on Borussia Dortmund in the UEFA Champions League at Emirates Stadium.
The boss gave an update on David Raya, as well as assessing our opponents, who sit top of the Bundesliga in Germany.
Read the full transcript below, with a video of the presser above!

on David Raya’s fitness:He’s not fit for tomorrow, unfortunately, but it doesn’t look too serious. We need some more tests tomorrow, but it’s quite encouraging. With the pain that he was showing immediately after the action, we were all quite worried, but he seems to be better than what we expected.

on how he got the injury:No, the doctors explained it’s quite technical, but when you look at the action, it doesn’t seem to be much on it, but the extent of the pain that he had and how he was struggling, it was quite worrying.
on the selection decision in goal:We always assess every situation to make the right call and it’s quite clear what we’re going to do.

on Dortmund’s season so far:Very impressed with them, you see the results so far, where they are in the Bundesliga at the top and where they are in the Champions League and especially the way they are playing, the way they are dominating games, the amount of threat they are able to create. We had them here in pre-season, and they showed the quality and what they are capable of, so we are very much aware of that. But we play at home in front of our crowd, and now we’re going to go and attack the game, that’s for sure.

on Noni Madueke’s form:He’s becoming decisive in games, and that’s what we need from our front players. He’s done it in various ways, which is something that I really like. He has added variety and much more connection within his games, rather than almost relying on one-to-one actions. I love his intensity as well without the ball, so he’s becoming a much more complete player I would say and I think he’s enjoying it a lot.

on what he’s looking for from Viktor Gyokeres:Very similar to the rest; we have rotated the team a lot, we have used the competitions as well to give minutes to players and exposure, because they are all starters in my opinion, and Viktor’s case is one of many that they’ve been in the same situation, whether they play in the Premier League or they play more in the Champions League, which is not bad.

on if he’s spoken to him about game time:No, we have conversations with every player to make sure that they understand what we are doing, to gather information about the way they are feeling, and so far, it’s been very positive with Viktor and with the rest of the team.

on if he’s happy about the Raya news:Yes, as I mentioned, we expected something much worse because he could almost not handle the amount of pain that he had at that moment, and the first test that we’ve done showed something that is much more encouraging. Tomorrow we need to reaffirm that to be able to give you some more specific information.
on if he needs surgery:There’s no need for surgery, which was the main fear especially because that would rule him out for months, so let’s see.
on if he could play against Manchester City:Again, tomorrow we’ll have more tests and we will know.

on if Raya is the biggest loss to the team:We’ve seen what David brings to the team, but as well that’s why we are very protective with Kepa and Illan, and everybody needs to be ready because these things unfortunately happen, and now we need to show how well we are protected and the good keepers we have with Kepa and Illan.

on Ethan Nwaneri's loan spell at Dortmund so far:Well, as you say, he started playing quite a lot, especially starting games, even though he didn't finish many games. Now, recently, he hasn't played that much. He needs to earn the right to play. He's playing at the top of the Bundesliga and the players have huge talent and quality and they are showing that and that's the reality of football. You go there and because you come from Arsenal, it doesn't give you any advantage, so you need to earn it. Ethan has, first of all, the mindset to do it and then the quality to do it and these things are part of a journey and part of a season and he needs to reveal himself and earn the right to win.
on if his team gets the credit for winning 14/18 matches this season:I think so. Our players and our club.

on what people say about our style:It depends on what you read. What I read is very positive and if I read about others, I can read positive. You just need to understand where that is coming from. But I think what we are all feeling around the club and the team and the players is very, very positive.

on Dortmund beating us in pre-season last summer:There's a reason why they are the top in the Bundesliga and they have won the number of games that they've done in the Champions League and again in the manner that they've done it. So we know that we play a top side tomorrow and we are ready for it.

on Jobe Bellingham's form and facing Jude Bellingham next month:I think you have to congratulate mum and dad for what he's done because it's incredible. I want you to look at the two of them and you put a different shirt on and it's incredible. Two amazing footballers; what they're doing is remarkable. So yeah, let's give credit to the parents.

on Kepa and Meslier splitting the League Cup minutes this season:I want everybody to be part of it and to feel part of it, you need to play and Illan has been really good with us and we believe that it was the right thing to share those minutes and to give a player that, every single day, is so consistent, so reliable, so supportive with the rest of the boys to have the feeling that we trust him as well.
on if one of them is the number two:I think it's clear for us who we're going to play tomorrow.

on if the team have to play differently without David Raya:We adapt to players' qualities, and they all have different ones. There are certain things that, in our game or in the way that we understand the game and we want to play the game, everybody has to be 100% committed to, but then we make adjustments in relation to the qualities of the players.

on if we're vulnerable from set pieces:Every time we concede a goal in the manner that we concede it, it's always disappointing, so we need to raise the level. We know that that's such an important part of the game to give you the highest probability to win. If you dominate that against any opponent, you're going to lose points, that's crystal clear and something that we need to improve.

on William Saliba's progress:There are steps, obviously, for the amount of time that he has trained with us right now to expose him in certain games, the competitive level is what it is. Now we talk about playing against the top teams in the Premier League and in the Champions League and that's a completely new world. The players need exposure and we'll find the right moments to do that.

on if he likes the current Champions League format:I do. To be fair, I enjoy it. It's much more work than it used to be because you have to analyse many more opponents. You test yourself constantly against top opposition and not only for us, but when you are watching some games as well during that period, there are some incredible games to watch. I think it has created more uncertainty, probably more openness; every game you have the urgency to win it, and you cannot manage the last few games or the advantage that you might think you have because every opponent is so tough.

on if he cannot rotate as much in the format:It was a closer competition so you knew what you had to do. You could control the results of other teams as well to understand what is going to require to get through and then you could manage yourself. Here you don’t because you don't know what the top sides are going to do and what you are going to find. It makes it more difficult. I think, in my opinion, it's much more open.

on if Noni has become a leader in the team:Great question because when you see his personality outside the pitch, he is a player that is so good at connecting with people and constantly talking and kidding and doing things and now he is doing that in a serious way on the pitch which is in my opinion really powerful. First of all because it keeps him connected and focused and I think that is going to translate on him having better actions and more volume of action which ultimately is going to give him the chance to decide games in my opinion.

on Kepa and Meslier stepping up:I think we have to try to prepare the players and how the players have to feel that they have to behave in order to earn the chance to win and to play. So far I have the feeling that whoever plays on that pitch is going to impact the game in the best possible way with their own quality, without asking somebody else to do what we expect from someone else.

on his midfield selection process:Well, in relation to what the game is going to demand and the relationship that we create within them, and then there is inevitably form. Form, at the end, dictates who is going to play more minutes and who is going to play less minutes. They are all in contention constantly and it's a way to think as well, how we are going to start and finish games? We are very lucky to have these kind of players in the team.

on the players feeling valued on and off the pitch:Caring about them. I don't know any other way but generally being caring about what happens with them and the way they feel as well. That's not something that goes in one direction as well because you feel generally for somebody or you have the necessity to ask somebody how he's feeling and try to help him when you feel that he cares as well about you. If it's only one way, it comes to a point where that's OK but you need to feel that that feeling basically is mutual and with the players, you can get that to a certain stage, to a certain moment, and when that relationship gets deeper, I think the player has to open up and the coach has to be ready to open up as well.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会：多特蒙德之战及雷亚伤情
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔出席欧冠对阵多特蒙德赛前发布会，并更新了雷亚的伤情。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔在酋长球场迎战欧洲冠军联赛对阵多特蒙德的比赛前接受了媒体采访。
主教练介绍了大卫·雷亚的最新情况，并对目前在德国德甲联赛中排名榜首的对手进行了评估。
请阅读下方的完整文字实录，并观看上方的新闻发布会视频！
关于大卫·雷亚的身体状况：不幸的是，他明天无法上场，但情况看起来似乎不是非常严重。我们明天需要做更多检查，但这相当令人鼓舞。根据他在受伤后立即表现出的疼痛感，我们当时都很担心，但他的情况似乎比我们预期的要好。
关于他是如何受伤的：没有，医生解释说这相当专业，但当你看到那个动作时，似乎并没有什么大不了的，但他所承受的疼痛程度以及他是如何苦苦支撑的，确实相当令人担忧。
关于门将位置的选择决定：我们总是评估每一种情况以做出正确的决定，而且我们接下来要做什么非常明确。
关于多特蒙德本赛季至今的表现：对他们印象非常深刻，看看他们到目前为止的战绩，他们在德甲联赛中排名榜首，在欧冠联赛中的位置，尤其是他们的踢球方式、统治比赛的方式以及他们能够创造的威胁数量。我们在季前赛中与他们交过手，他们展现出了实力和能力，所以我们非常清楚这一点。但我们在主场作战，在球迷面前，现在我们要全力以赴去进攻这场比赛，这是肯定的。
关于诺尼·马杜埃凯的状态：他正在比赛中变得具有决定性，这正是我们对锋线球员的要求。他以各种不同的方式做到了这一点，这也是我非常喜欢的一点。他在比赛中增加了多样性以及更多的联系，而不仅仅是依赖一对一的突破。我也很喜欢他在无球状态下的积极性，所以我可以说他正在成为一名更全面的球员，而且我认为他非常享受这一点。
关于他对维克托·哲凯赖什的期望：与其他人非常相似；我们对球队进行了很多轮换，我们也利用各项赛事为球员提供出场时间和锻炼机会，因为在我看来他们都是首发球员，维克托的情况是许多处于相同境况的球员之一，无论他们是在英超联赛中出场，还是在欧冠联赛中出场更多，这都不算坏。
关于他是否与球员谈过出场时间：没有，我们与每位球员进行交谈，以确保他们理解我们在做什么，收集关于他们感受的信息，到目前为止，与维克托以及球队其他成员的沟通都非常积极。
关于他对雷亚的消息是否感到高兴：是的，正如我所提到的，我们曾预计情况会更糟，因为他在那一刻几乎无法忍受疼痛，而我们所做的第一次检查显示的情况要令人鼓舞得多。明天我们需要再次确认这一点，以便向大家提供更具体的信息。
关于他是否需要手术：不需要手术，这是大家主要的担忧，因为那会让他缺阵数月，所以我们拭目以待。
关于他能否对阵曼城：同样，明天我们会做更多的检查，然后就会知道了。
关于雷亚是否是球队最大的损失：我们已经看到了大卫给球队带来的贡献，但这也是为什么我们要对凯帕和伊兰（梅斯利埃）进行保护，每个人都需要做好准备，因为这些事情不幸会发生，现在我们需要展现出我们拥有很好的保护以及凯帕和伊兰这样优秀的门将。

关于伊森·恩瓦内里目前在多特蒙德的租借期：正如你所说，他开始踢很多比赛，特别是首发登场，尽管他没有踢完整场比赛。现在，最近他没有踢那么多比赛。他需要赢得比赛的权利。他在德甲顶级联赛踢球，球员们拥有巨大的天赋和质量，他们正在展现这一点，这就是足球的现实。你去那里，因为你来自阿森纳，并不会给你带来任何优势，所以你需要靠自己去赢得它。伊森首先具备这样做的心态，其次具备这样做的质量，这些都是征程和赛季的一部分，他需要展现自己并赢得胜利的权利。
关于他的球队赢得本赛季18场比赛中的14场是否应该获得赞誉：我想是的。我们的球员和我们的俱乐部应该获得赞誉。
关于人们对我们风格的评价：这取决于你读到的是什么。我读到的非常积极，如果我读到关于其他人的报道，我也能读到积极的内容。你只需要了解这些声音来自哪里。但我认为我们在俱乐部、球队和球员周围感受到的氛围非常、非常积极。
关于多特蒙德去年夏天在季前赛中击败我们：他们成为德甲榜首以及在欧冠中赢得如此多场比赛是有原因的，而且再次是以那种方式。所以我们知道明天我们将面对一支顶尖球队，我们已经为此做好了准备。
关于若布·贝林厄姆的状态以及下个月面对祖德·贝林厄姆：我认为你必须祝贺他的父母，因为他所做的一切太不可思议了。我想让你们看看他们两个，你穿上不同的球衣，这太不可思议了。两个出色的足球运动员；他们正在做的事情非常了不起。所以，是的，要把功劳归于他们的父母。
关于凯帕和梅斯利埃本赛季分担联赛杯的出场时间：我希望每个人都能参与其中，要感受到自己是其中的一部分，你需要踢球，伊兰对我们来说真的很好，我们相信分享这些出场时间是正确的做法，让一个每天都如此稳定、如此可靠、对其他队友如此支持的球员，感受到我们也同样信任他。
关于其中一人是否是二号门将：我认为我们明天让谁上场对我们来说是很清楚的。
关于没有大卫·雷亚球队是否必须以不同方式踢球：我们适应球员的特点，他们每个人都有不同的特点。在我们的比赛中，或者在我们对比赛的理解以及我们想要踢比赛的方式中，有些特定的事情每个人都必须100%投入，但随后我们会根据球员的特点进行调整。
关于我们在定位球防守上是否脆弱：每次我们以那种方式丢球，总是令人失望的，所以我们需要提高水平。我们知道这是比赛中如此重要的一部分，能给你带来赢得比赛最高概率。如果你对任何对手在这方面占据统治地位，你就会丢分，这是显而易见的，也是我们需要改进的地方。
关于威廉·萨利巴的进展：显然，考虑到他目前与我们一起训练的时间量，要在某些比赛中派他上场，竞争水平就是这样。现在我们谈论的是在英超联赛和欧冠联赛中对阵顶尖球队，这是一个完全崭新的世界。球员需要锻炼，我们会找到合适的时机来做到这一点。
关于他是否喜欢当前的欧冠赛制：我确实喜欢。说实话，我很享受。这比以前的工作量要大得多，因为你必须分析更多的对手。你不时地在顶级对手面前检验自己，不仅对我们来说，而且当你在这期间观看一些比赛时，有一些令人难以置信的比赛可看。我认为它创造了更多的不确定性，可能更开放；每场比赛你都有取胜的紧迫感，你无法掌控最后几场比赛或者你可能认为自己拥有的优势，因为每个对手都非常强大。
关于他是否在这个赛制中无法进行那么多轮换：这是一项更紧凑的赛事，所以你知道你必须做什么。你还可以控制其他球队的比赛结果，以了解晋级需要什么，然后你可以掌控自己。在这里你做不到，因为你不知道顶级球队会做什么，你会遇到什么。这使得它更加困难。在我看来，它更加开放。
关于诺尼是否已经成为球队的领袖：这是一个很好的问题，因为当你看到他在球场外的个性时，他是一个非常擅长与人交往、不断聊天、开玩笑和做事的人，现在他在球场上以一种严肃的方式做到这一点，在我看来这非常具有力量。首先，这让他保持联系和专注，我认为这会转化为他更好的表现和更多的行动量，最终这将在我看来给他带来决定比赛的机会。
关于凯帕和梅斯利埃挺身而出：我认为我们必须努力让球员做好准备，球员必须感受到他们必须如何表现，才能赢得赢得比赛和上场比赛的机会。到目前为止，我的感觉是，无论谁在球场上，都会以最好的方式用他们自己的品质对比赛产生影响，而不需要要求别人去做我们期望别人去做的事情。
关于他的中场选择过程：好吧，这与比赛的要求以及我们在他们之间建立的默契有关，然后不可避免地还有状态。状态最终决定了谁将踢更多的时间，谁将踢更少的时间。他们都在不断地竞争，这也是一种思考方式，我们如何开始和结束比赛？我们非常幸运球队中有这样类型的球员。

关于球员在场内场外是否都感到被重视：关心他们。我不知道还有什么其他方式，但要真正关心他们发生的事情以及他们的感受。这不是单向的事情，因为你真心为一个人的事情感到关切，或者当你觉得他也关心你时，你有必要去问问他的感受并尝试帮助他。如果只是单向的，到了某个时刻那也可以，但你需要感受到这种感觉基本上是相互的，而对于球员来说，你可以将这种关系发展到某个阶段、某个时刻，当这种关系变得更深时，我认为球员必须敞开心扉，教练也必须准备好敞开心扉。

items.titleEn: World Cup places on the line for international Gunners
items.summaryEn: 18 AWFC players have been called up, with several playing World Cup play-offs
bodyEn: Several Gunners, including four Lionesses, will be looking to secure a place at the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup after being called up to represent their national teams in November/December.
10 of our 16 senior call-ups will be vying for places at next summer's finals in Brazil, with the other six competing in international friendlies.
We'll also have two young Gunners in the England under-19s squad in a bumper break for Arsenal interest.
ALL OR NOTHING EUROPEAN PLAY-OFFS
The final seven European places at the World Cup, as well as the inter-confederation play-off place, will be decided in two-leg knockout ties over the course of the next two weeks.
Eight ties will take place, with the seven highest ranked winners progressing directly to the World Cup, while the lowest ranked winner will head to the inter-confederation play-offs.
The first legs of each tie will take place on Tuesday, December 1, before the return legs, hosted by the higher ranked sides, on Saturday, December 5.

England headline the ties, with Taylor Hinds, Alessia Russo, Georgia Stanway and national team captain Leah Williamson taking on Ukraine in a must-win tie. The Lionesses travel to Spain to for the first leg, before the decisive second leg takes place at Wembley.

Frida Maanum's Norway face Wales, with the first leg in Cardiff before the return in Oslo, while Daphne van Domselaar, who returned to our starting XI against West Ham on Sunday, will be hoping to make her first international appearance of the season as her Netherlands side take on Slovenia.

Smilla Holmberg and Sweden will face Scotland, starting away in Paisley before the return leg in Stockholm. Geraldine Reuteler's Switzerland will start their play-off tie against Austria at home, before heading to Vienna for the second leg.
US & CANADA GO FOR SILVERWARE
Emily Fox's USA and Olivia Smith's Canada could meet in the final of the CONCACAF W Championship, with World Cup and Olympics places up for grabs, as well as the title itself.

Eight teams have qualified for the tournament finals, with the winners of each quarter-final qualifying for the 2027 World Cup. Hosts USA will take on El Salvador before Canada face Panama in the last eight.
If the USA beat Panama, the other three semi-finalists will join them at the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles, with the Americans already qualified as hosts.
The losers of the quarter-finals will enter a secondary qualifying round for the inter-confederation World Cup play-offs, with the losers eliminated from World Cup contention.
FRIENDLIES FOR QUALIFIED GUNNERS
League phase group winners Denmark, France, Germany and Spain have already qualified for the finals, and will play friendlies while their European rivals fight for the remaining World Cup places.

Isabella Damm has been called up for Denmark for their friendly against Zambia in Esbjerg, while Elisa de Almeida's France host Venezuela and Morocco in Tomblaine and Montbeliard respectively. Spain, with Misa Rodriguez in their ranks, take on Chile and Venezuela at home.

Australia have also secured a World Cup spot, and will face Colombia in two home friendlies, with Steph Catley, Kyra Cooney-Cross and Caitlin Foord all returning to their home country to take on the South American side.

As well as our senior internationals, we'll have two Gunners in youth international action. Bella Cowley and Phoebe De Bohan have both been chosen to represent the young Lionesses as they take on Denmark in two friendlies in Turkiye.
Our Gunners will return from international action for our Women's Super League clash away to Everton on Friday, December 11.
Lisa Baum was due to join up with Germany for a trip to South America to take on Argentina and Chile, but has withdrawn from her national team to rest and recover over the international break.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳女足球员将出征国际比赛，世界杯名额悬于一线
items.summaryZh: 18名阿森纳女足球员获得国家队征召，多人将参加世界杯附加赛。
bodyZh: 在11月/12月的国家队比赛日期间，多名阿森纳球员（包括四名英格兰女足球员）将出征并力争锁定2027年国际足联女足世界杯的参赛资格。
在我们入选成年国家队的16名球员中，有10人将争夺明年夏天在巴西举行的决赛圈名额，另外6人则将参加国际友谊赛。
此外，还将有两名年轻的阿森纳球员入选英格兰U19青年队，展现了阿森纳强大的国脚阵容。
生死攸关的欧洲附加赛
在接下来的两周内，世界杯欧洲区的最后七个名额以及跨洲附加赛名额将通过两回合淘汰赛决出。
将进行八场对决，其中排名最高的七个胜者将直接晋级世界杯，而排名最低的胜者将进入跨洲附加赛。
各场比赛的首回合将于12月1日星期二进行，随后由排名较高的球队主场作战的次回合将于12月5日星期星期六进行。
英格兰队是本轮焦点战的主角，泰勒·海因兹、阿莱西亚·鲁索、Georgia Stanway以及国家队队长莉亚·威廉姆森将在一场不容有失的比赛中对阵乌克兰。英格兰队将前往西班牙进行首回合比赛，随后在温布利球场进行决定性的次回合比赛。
弗里达·马努姆领衔的挪威队将对阵威尔士，首回合在卡迪夫，次回合在奥斯陆；而达芙妮·范多姆塞拉尔（在周日对阵西汉姆联的比赛中重回首发阵容）则希望在荷兰队对阵斯洛文尼亚的比赛中完成本赛季的首次国家队出场。
斯米拉·霍姆伯格和瑞典队将对阵苏格兰，首回合客场作战，次回合回到斯德哥尔摩。杰拉尔丁·罗伊特勒的瑞士队将在主场迎战奥地利，随后前往维也纳进行次回合比赛。
美国与加拿大冲击冠军奖杯
埃米莉·福克斯所在的美国队和奥利维亚·史密斯所在的加拿大队可能会在中北美及加勒比海女足锦标赛决赛中相遇，届时世界杯和奥运会名额以及冠军奖杯都将成为争夺的目标。
共有八支球队晋级决赛圈，每个四分之一决赛的胜者将获得2027年世界杯的参赛资格。东道主美国队将在八强赛中对阵萨尔瓦多，而加拿大队将对阵巴拿马。
如果美国队击败巴拿马，其他三个半决赛队伍将与他们一起参加2028年洛杉矶奥运会，美国队则已作为东道主自动晋级。
四分之一决赛的失利者将进入世界杯跨洲附加赛的第二轮资格赛，失利者将被淘汰出世界杯争夺战。
已晋级球队的友谊赛
小组赛阶段头名丹麦、法国、德国和西班牙已经晋级决赛圈，将在欧洲死敌争夺剩余世界杯名额的同时进行友谊赛。
伊莎贝拉·达姆已被丹麦队征召，将在埃斯比约与赞比亚进行友谊赛；Elisa de Almeida所在的法国队分别在汤布兰和蒙贝利亚尔主场迎战委内瑞拉和摩洛哥。拥有米莎·罗德里格斯的西班牙队将在主场对阵智利和委内瑞拉。
澳大利亚也已经拿到了世界杯席位，将在两场主场友谊赛中对阵哥伦比亚，斯蒂芬·卡特利、基拉·库尼-克罗斯和凯特琳·福德都将返回祖国迎战南美对手。
除了成年国家队球员外，我们还有两名年轻球员将参加青年队国际比赛。贝拉·考利和菲比·德博汉已被选中代表英格兰U19青年队在土耳其与丹麦进行两场友谊赛。
我们的国脚们将在国际比赛结束后归队，备战12月11日星期五客场对阵埃弗顿的女子超级联赛。
莉萨·鲍姆原本要随德国队前往南美对阵阿根廷和智利，但她已退出国家队，以便在国际比赛日期间休息和恢复。

items.titleEn: Loan Watch: Setford’s penalty heroics win it for Stevenage
items.summaryEn: The latest on our loanees in 2026/27
bodyEn: Ethan Nwaneri was once again on the winning side for Borussia Dortmund as they moved top of the Bundesliga with a late win at Borussia Monchengladbach.

The teenager was a late substitute as Felix Nmecha’s winner elevated BVB above Bayern Munich to the summit, maintaining an unbeaten league start. Ethan, who also registered two assists for England Under-21s against France last Monday, reunites with Arsenal this Tuesday night and is eligible to play against his parent club at Emirates Stadium in the Champions League.

Tommy Setford produced a player-of-the-match display for Stevenage in their 1-0 win at Notts County in League One on Saturday, saving a penalty with the game goalless and making three further stops to maintain a hard-fought clean sheet. Tommy denied Conor Grant from the spot in the 84th minute at Meadow Lane, before Josh Magennis scored the decisive goal just two minutes later.

Ismeal Kabia returned to club action with St Mirren on Saturday following the international break, but their toughest league test of the season on paper resulted in a 4-1 defeat away at Celtic. Ismeal played the full match at Celtic Park, his second game back since a minor injury absence.

The survival battle will soon come to an end for Charles Sagoe Jr and Kalmar, with Monday night offering the Swedish outfit’s penultimate league fixture of the 2026 season away at Orgryte. A point would seal Kalmar’s place in the Allsvenskan for next season before their final match at home to AIK.

Khari Ranson’s loan at Billericay Town is going from strength to strength, with the young goalkeeper securing his first clean sheet last Tuesday in a 0-0 away draw at Truro City. The long trip to Cornwall was followed up by Saturday’s home fixture with Slough Town, which the Ricay won 4-1 with Khari once again between the sticks. They sit sixth in the National League South, unbeaten in the league since August.

Jessie Gale returned to action for Newcastle United Women in the League Cup’s league phase on Sunday, as the Magpies went down 2-0 to Nottingham Forest in Gateshead. Jessie was introduced in the 54th minute of the match, with the two-goal deficit already present.

Cecily Wellesley-Smith’s loan spell with Rosengard in Sweden will now formally come to an end following the conclusion of the Women’s domestic season in the country. Rosengard have been relegated to the second tier following a two-legged promotion/relegation play-off tie with Orebro, who finished third in the league below and will now take their place in the Allsvenskan. Cecily did not feature in either of the games on Thursday nor Sunday, which resulted in a 5-4 aggregate defeat.

It was a winning note for Sophie Harwood on Sunday in the League Cup league phase, as her Sheffield United side routed Durham 5-1 in Scunthorpe. Having been first-choice in the WSL 2 backline for the Blades, Sophie was rotated in the cup but entered the fray in the 63rd minute, at which point the scoreline was just 2-1.

items.summaryZh: 了解我们2026/27赛季外租球员的最新表现。
bodyZh: 伊森·恩瓦内里再次随多特蒙德取得胜利，他们凭借一场尾声阶段的绝杀客场击败门兴格拉德巴赫，登顶德甲积分榜首。
这名少将在比赛尾声替补登场，费利克斯·恩梅查的绝杀帮助多特超越拜仁慕尼黑升至榜首，延续了联赛开局不败的纪录。上周一代表英格兰U21对阵法国时贡献两次助攻的伊森，将于本周二晚重回阿森纳，他有资格在欧冠联赛中代表母队在酋长球场出战。
汤米·塞特福德周六在英甲联赛斯蒂夫尼奇客场1-0击败诺茨郡的比赛中荣膺全场最佳球员，他在比分互交白卷时扑出一粒点球，随后又做出三次扑救，艰难地力保城门不失。在美度巷球场，汤米在第84分钟扑出了康诺·格兰特的点球，仅仅两分钟后，乔什·马根尼斯便攻入了制胜球。
国际比赛日过后，伊斯迈尔·卡比亚于周六重返圣米伦俱乐部赛场，但在纸面上本赛季最艰难的一场联赛中，他们客场1-4不敌凯尔特人。伊斯迈尔在凯尔特人公园球场踢满全场，这是他在伤缺初愈后迎来的第二场比赛。
对于查尔斯·萨戈二世和卡尔马而言，保级之战即将落下帷幕，周一晚这支瑞典球队将在客场对阵奥尔格里特，迎来2026赛季倒数第二轮联赛。只要拿到一个积分，卡尔马就能在最后一轮主场对阵AIK之前，提前锁定下赛季的瑞典超资格。
卡里·兰森在比勒里凯镇的租借之旅渐入佳境，这位年轻门将上周二在客场0-0战平特鲁罗城的比赛中收获了个人首场零封。在经历远赴康沃尔的客场之旅后，球队又在周六迎战主场对阵斯劳镇的比赛，卡里再次镇守球门，帮助球队4-1取胜。目前他们在国家联赛南部积分榜上排名第六，自8月以来联赛保持不败。
杰西·盖尔周日重返纽卡斯尔联女足，参加了联赛杯小组阶段的比赛，喜鹊在盖茨黑德0-2不敌诺丁汉森林。杰西在第54分钟替补登场，当时球队已经两球落后。
随着瑞典国内女足赛季的结束，塞西莉·韦尔斯利-史密斯在罗森加德的租借期也正式画上句号。在与厄勒布鲁的两回合升降级附加赛失利后，罗森加德不幸降入第二级别联赛，而厄勒布鲁在低级别联赛获得第三名，将取而代之升入瑞典超。塞西莉没有在周四和周日的两场比赛中登场，球队最终以4-5的总比分落败。
索菲·哈伍德在周日的联赛杯小组阶段迎来了胜利，她所在的谢菲尔德联队在斯肯索普5-1大胜达勒姆。作为刀锋军团WSL 2后防线上的首选，索菲在杯赛中得到轮换，但在第63分钟替补登场，当时场上比分为2-1。

bodyEn: Fulham v ArsenalWednesday 30th December Premier LeagueCraven CottageKick Off: 19:30

All tickets for this game will be NFC Digital Passes and will be sent to each lead client and must be added to a mobile device prior to arrival at Craven Cottage. Please ensure that your email address details are up to date.
Tickets will be sent from Tuesday, December 22. If you have not received your tickets by Tuesday, December 29, please contact our Supporter Services Team on 020 7619 5000 (option 1).
Supporters aged 13 and under must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over when entering Craven Cottage.
Please read the matchday information for details on what to expect when visiting Craven Cottage – Visiting Craven Cottage Information

We ask that you only purchase a ticket if you are planning to attend the match. Our goal is to ensure that as many supporters as possible have the chance to attend this game, and that our away support remains vibrant and passionate.
When attending away fixtures, please ensure that your match ticket is scanned. It is your responsibility to make sure that your ticket is scanned correctly at the turnstile.
If your match ticket does not scan at the relevant turnstile, or if a steward admits you through another entrance, please ensure that your ticket is scanned before entering the ground.

If you do have access issues on the day of the game, please speak to a steward or seek advice from the hosting club’s ticket office before entering the ground to confirm that your match attendance is recorded.

Arsenal monitors away match attendance from access control data which is recorded at the hosting club’s ground. Arsenal receives this information directly from the hosting club and uses the data to confirm attendance or to deduct away match points.
Please be aware that documentation will not be accepted to prove away match attendance and this includes photographs, receipts, travel or hotel bookings.

If you fail to scan your away match ticket, Arsenal will not receive information that you attended the fixture, and the away match loyalty point that has been credited to your membership account will be removed for the relevant away game.
The club also reserves the right to implement further point removals for repeated occurrences as set out under section 3.10 of the Arsenal Away Match Ticket Terms and Conditions Season 2026-2027.

items.titleEn: Disabled Supporters' Ticket Information | Sabah (H)
bodyEn: Arsenal v SabahWednesday 27th JanuaryChampions LeagueArsenal StadiumKick Off: 20:00
This will be a Category C fixture (pricing and information on match categorisation).
Please note that all four home UEFA Champions League, league phase games are included within the cost of the Arsenal Platinum and 23-game Gold season ticket.
We are improving this option for the 2026/2027 season by offering a guaranteed purchase window for UEFA competition league phase games for 19-game Gold season ticket holders.
Important Information

To ensure that home section tickets are purchased by genuine Arsenal supporters, this match has a ballot and purchase embargo in place. This means that fans who purchase an Arsenal membership after Wednesday, August 28, 2026, will not be permitted to purchase tickets for this game.
Sales Phases

If you are a 19 Game Gold Season Ticket holder, please note that you can purchase your own season ticket seat(s) from 12pm on Wednesday, December 2. The seat(s) will be reserved online and held until 5pm on Thursday, December 3, and there will be no booking fee during this priority booking period.

If you are a 19 Game Gold Season Ticket holder and hold a concession price season ticket, please note that your seat has already been reserved to the correct concession. This can be found in the “My Account” section under reserved seats. You will be able to amend this online when booking, should you wish to upgrade to an adult ticket. Please note that if you upgrade a concession ticket but wish to change back to the original price before making a purchase, you must log out and log back in to default your seat back to the original concession price.
Further instructions on how to purchase your own seat.
Please note, if you are unable to add the Personal Assistant ticket to your basket, we will manually process this for you after you have purchased your match ticket. You will not need to contact us.
Ballot System for Disability Access Members
To ensure fairness and equal opportunity, tickets for all home fixtures will be sold via a ballot system exclusively for Arsenal Members.

Members will have a designated window to enter the ballot. You can choose to register individually or as a group of up to four members, if all supporters meet the necessary requirements. You can enter at any stage during the registration window, and your odds of success will remain the same.

Timing doesn't matter when it comes to entering our ballots, whether you are an early bird or a last-minute entrant, your chances of winning remain the same. The only crucial factor is that you submit your entry whilst the window is open.
Ballot opens: Friday 4th December at 10am
Ballot closes: Monday 7th December at 12pm
Please do not enter via your online account as this will not work for DA members.

All applicants, whether successful or unsuccessful, will be notified by email only, by 2pm on Tuesday 8th December. Successful applicants will have the opportunity to purchase tickets during the designated priority booking window, as specified on the ticket information page.

This fixture will be on sale on Wednesday 9th December at 10am and successful applicants will be able to access their online account to purchase tickets, this will include a complimentary Personal Assistant ticket, subject to eligibility. Please note, you will have until 10am on Thursday 10th December to purchase your tickets.
Where the number of ballot registrations for a match does not exceed the number of available tickets, all Members who have entered will be successful.
Useful links
Ticket Exchange & Ticket Transfer

If a Member is unable to attend a match they were successful in the ballot for, and that match has sold out, they will have the option to post their ticket on our Ticket Exchange platform. This way, other fans can purchase the ticket and enjoy the match. This ticket information page will be updated once a fixture has sold out and Ticket Exchange is available.
Ticket Transfer is available for Season Ticket Holders to use once a game is available online (4-8 weeks before a game).

Disability Access members who wish to list their tickets on the Ticket Exchange should complete the online form here. Please note this form is for DA members only and tickets will be listed by the Disability Liaison Team. The Disability Liaison Team can be contacted by calling 0207 619 5000 (Option 2). Deaf supporters, who use British Sign Language (BSL), can contact the Disability Liaison Team by using SignVideo BSL Interpreter service.

EmbargoIn addition, season ticket holders are only permitted to transfer tickets via the Ticket Transfer service to a recipient whose account was created on or before the Wednesday, August 26, 2026, for this game. Tickets forwarded to supporters whose accounts were created after this date will not be able to accept the transfer, and the transfer will be cancelled.
The Arsenal App

This latest update to the Arsenal app means access to the Ticket Hub has changed. To continue to manage your tickets via the Ticket Hub, you must ensure you have the latest version of The Arsenal app and log in to your account using your email/username and password.
Digital TicketsAny tickets purchased by members for the 2026/2027 season, will be loaded onto their digital membership pass via the official Arsenal app.

Once the digital pass has been added to an Apple or Android wallet, any purchased tickets will automatically show on the digital pass approximately one week before the relevant fixture. Click here for more information.
Stadium Access Please note that you MUST enter the Stadium with your Personal Assistant, if eligible.
Code of Conduct All fans must adhere to our updated Code of Conduct; please take your time to read this information carefully.
Accessible ParkingThe Accessible Parking booking period will open on Wednesday 16th December and will close once we have no spaces remaining. You can view the parking information here.

items.titleEn: ‘Obviously it’s not good’: Arteta sweating over David Raya’s fitness after injury
items.summaryEn: Keeper close to tears at Newcastle after hurting shoulderArsenal held 2-2, with Jaissle hailing ‘excellent’ displayArsenal were left sweating on the fitness of their goalkeeper David Raya after the Spaniard was forced off with a shoulder injury during the second half of the 2-2 draw at Newcastle on Saturday evening.It left Mikel Arteta’s side six points clear of Brighton and Manchester City at the top of the Premier League but Arsenal’s manager was more concerned about Raya following an accidental collision with Newcastle’s William Osula. The Spaniard was helped off in evident pain and looked close to tears. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal were left sweating on the fitness of their goalkeeper David Raya after the Spaniard was forced off with a shoulder injury during the second half of the 2-2 draw at Newcastle on Saturday evening.

It left Mikel Arteta’s side six points clear of Brighton and Manchester City at the top of the Premier League but Arsenal’s manager was more concerned about Raya following an accidental collision with Newcastle’s William Osula. The Spaniard was helped off in evident pain and looked close to tears.

“Obviously it’s not good David had to come off but at the moment I don’t know [the prognosis],” said Arteta, explaining that a keeper who kept seven clean sheets in the season’s opening 10 games will have the joint scanned on Sunday. “He will have an MRI tomorrow. We will have more information tomorrow. But we know how important David is to us.”

Arsenal were 1-0 up at half-time at St James’ Park thanks to a goal from Eberechi Eze during an opening 45 minutes dominated by the visitors. Newcastle, though, improved significantly after the break and took the lead thanks to goals from Harvey Barnes and Malick Thiaw before Noni Madueke equalised.
In the Guardian app, tap the Profile settings button at the top right, then select Notifications. Turn on sport notifications.
If you already have the Guardian app, make sure you’re on the most recent version.
If you don't have the Guardian app, download it from the iOS App Store on iPhone or the Google Play store on Android by searching for 'The Guardian'.

“My feeling is we have lost two points,” said Arteta. “We were exceptional in the first half but we needed to score three or four goals and we didn’t. We knew there’d be a response but the way we gave Newcastle’s first goal away was completely unacceptable. We came back and scored a second goal but we lacked the moment of magic to kill the game. I don’t think we switched off in the second half; sometimes you have to praise the opposition.”

Matthias Jaissle was left smiling after that second-half performance rescued a game watched by Newcastle’s chair, Yasir al-Rumayyan. He had flown in from Riyadh to witness his first match of the season and is believed to have complimented his head coach afterwards.

“What you saw in the second half was Newcastle’s DNA par excellence and that’s something we can build on,” said Jaissle. “But we’ve got to be humble and realistic. The first half was not good and the second half was excellent. I’ve got mixed feelings because a little more was possible but a point was probably fair.

“I was a bit frustrated at half-time but we encouraged the players to do the high press in the right way and adopt a front-foot approach. There was no hesitating, no doubting, just pure belief and we clicked. I knew we were able to do it, so I was really pleased. We felt unbelievable connections and synergy with the crowd.
“To get a team as good as Arsenal shaking in your stadium was unbelievable. I hope we can carry on this feeling.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔：显然这不太好，拉亚因伤引发担忧
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳门将大卫·拉亚肩膀受伤，阿尔特塔表示将接受核磁共振检查。
bodyZh: 周六晚在纽卡斯尔2-2战平的比赛中，阿森纳门将大卫·拉亚在下半场因肩膀受伤被迫离场，俱乐部对他的身体状况感到担忧。
这使得米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在英超积分榜上位居榜首，领先布莱顿和曼城六分，但由于拉亚与纽卡斯尔球员威廉·奥苏拉发生意外碰撞，阿森纳主帅对他的情况更加关切。这名西班牙门将在明显的痛苦中被搀扶离场，看起来快要哭了。
“显然大卫不得不离场并不是件好事，但目前我（还不知道伤情预测），”阿尔特塔解释说，这名在本赛季前10场比赛中完成7次零封的门将将在周日接受关节扫描。“他明天将进行核磁共振检查。我们明天会有更多信息。但我们知道大卫对我们有多重要。”
凭借埃贝雷奇·埃泽在上半场的进球，在由客队占优的前45分钟过后，阿森纳在圣詹姆斯公园球场以1-0领先。然而，纽卡斯尔在中场休息后表现显著提升，凭借哈维·巴恩斯和马利克·佳夫的进球取得领先，随后马杜埃凯扳平了比分。
在卫报应用程序中，点击右上角的“个人资料设置”按钮，然后选择“通知”。开启体育通知。
如果您已经拥有卫报应用程序，请确保您使用的是最新版本。
如果您还没有卫报应用程序，可以在iPhone的iOS App Store或Android的Google Play商店搜索“The Guardian”进行下载。
“我的感觉是我们丢了两分，”阿尔特塔说。“我们在上半场表现极其出色，但我们需要打进三到四个球，而我们没有做到。我们知道对方会有所回应，但我们送给纽卡斯尔第一个球的方式完全不可接受。我们扳平并打进了第二个球，但我们缺少杀死比赛的神来之笔。我不认为我们在下半场松懈了；有时候你必须称赞对手。”
下半场的出色表现挽救了这场比赛，也让在现场观看比赛的纽卡斯尔主席亚西尔·阿勒鲁梅扬露出了笑容。他从利雅得飞来观看他本赛季的第一场比赛，据信他在赛后称赞了主教练。
“你在下半场看到的是纯粹的纽卡斯尔基因，这是我们可以继续建立的基础，”雅伊斯勒说。“但我们必须保持谦逊和现实。上半场表现不好，下半场非常出色。我的心情很复杂，因为本可能取得更多成果，但平局可能算是公平的。”
“我在中场休息时有点沮丧，但我们鼓励球员以正确的方式进行高位逼抢并采取积极主动的姿态。没有犹豫，没有怀疑，只有纯粹的信念，我们做到了。我知道我们有能力做到这一点，所以我真的很高兴。我们感受到了与球迷之间难以置信的联系和协同效应。”
“能让像阿森纳这样优秀的球队在你们的球场感到畏惧是不可思议的。我希望我们能将这种感觉延续下去。”

items.titleEn: Newcastle United 2-2 Arsenal: Premier League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Newcastle roared back to take in a thrilling second half before Noni Madueke’s equaliser earned Arsenal a point“There is an ebb and a flow to Arsenal’s front three, isn’t there?” writes Charles Antaki. “Eze, Havertz, Madueke – in any given game, one will delight and the other two disappoint; one will score and the other two will be all over the place; one will bring joy, and the other two will invite cursing and the gnashing of teeth. And all this is not to mention the chap lurking on the bench. Personally – I admit it – I’d rather have three fully functioning goal machines, but there we are.”We hate it when our teams become successful.He’s prepared emotionally; he knows to accept. We have to be very dominant emotionally to attack Newcastle in the way we want, and he’s ready to do that. Continue reading...
bodyEn: That’s all for tonight. Thank you for your company and especially all the lovely emails, which have left me feeling warm, fuzzy and a bit emotional. Goodnight!
Louise Taylor’s match report: Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal
If Mikel Arteta was delighted to see the back of Eddie Howe as Newcastle’s head coach, the bad news is that another similarly awkward technical area adversary has been installed at St James’ Park.

If Arsenal’s manager never seemed to relish trips to face Howe’s old team, Arteta certainly did not enjoy this latest trip to Tyneside where Matthias Jaissle’s initially overwhelmed team fought back to earn a point courtesy of a stellar second-half performance.

“That ended up being a great game,” writes Chris Paraskevas, “and while a win would have given PIF & MJ a massive psychological boost, this is a reminder of the necessary template for home games: get in the opposition’s face and make them uncomfortable and move the ball quickly and forwards, because the Geordies respond to hard work and endeavour more than they fancy concepts like vertical football.

“A draw is probably fair. Some encouraging performances from a number of players. Now they need to find some consistency. And I need to use the rest of my Sunday to hook up a date/get to 25% completion on GTA VI. Take care of yourself mate - great to have you back!”
Cheers Chris. It’s great to be back, especially when I get to work on games like that.
The updated Premier League table

That was a blistering second half, one that has the potential to kickstart Matthias Jaissle’s reign. He made a triple substitution at half-time, with Newcastle 1-0 down and being comprehensively outplayed. The impact was instant, and for the next half an hour Newcastle battered the best team in England.
Harvey Barnes equalised, Malick Thiaw put them in front and they came close to take a 3-1 lead before Noni Madueke scored the equaliser for Arsenal. Great entertainment, lovely stuff.
… but it’s over now. Barnes is booked after the final whistle, presumably because the referee thought he dived when Rice challenged him.
90+10 min Barnes thinks he’s fouled on the edge of the area by Rice. The referee disagrees. Pulsating stuff…
90+8 min At the other end, Gyokeres curls over from the left side of the area. A tougher chance than Ramsey’s – the angle was tighter and he was under more pressure.

90+7 mim Barnes leaves Rice in his slipstream, turns inside and finds Ramsey to his right. He moves to the edge of the area, opens his body and… sidefoots high over the bar. Ach, that was half a chance. The ball may have bobbled.
90+6 min Barnes moves promisingly down the left, only to lift a cross into the arms of Kepa.
90+4 min: Double substitution for Arsenal Viktor Gyokeres and Mikel Merino, a specialist in late winners, replace Martin Odegaard and Kai Havertz.
90+2 min: Newcastle substitution Sven Botman replaces the limping Lewis Hall, whose error for the opening goal feels a long time ago.
90 min Oh go on then: there will be nine minutes of extra entertainment.
90 min Madueke’s corner from the right brushes the head of Thiaw and bounces a few yards wide of the far post. Eeeeeeeeeeeeesh this is tense.
87 min At the other end, Ramsey nips in front of Timber (I think) to make an important clearance.
85 min Ramsey, who has been excellent since coming on at half-time, wins a corner on the left. Neither team looks happy with a point.
84 min A Newcastle free-kick leads to a shot from Thiaw that deflects wide. He was offside anyway, so what’s your flippin’ point?
83 min: Newcastle substitution Yoane Wissa on, Joe Willock off.
81 min Arsenal came from behind to nick a late win at St James’ Park this season. There’s a bit of metaphorical lightning in the air.
80 min Burn gives Timber a mouthful after fouling him near the touchline. Madueke charges in and squares up to Burn, a brave move that almost leads to Burn putting him on his rump.
Burn and Madueke are booked.

Noni Madueke continues his excellent form with a vital goal. It came from a superb counter-attack, led inevitably by Odegaard. He played the ball outside to Madueke, who veered infield and into the area with inent. Madueke dummied a couple of defenders before hitting a deflected shot from 15 yards that squirmed through Hornicek.
Arsenal equalise out of nothing!

75 min: Chance for Newcastle Kepa dives at the feet of Miley, who surged through after the deftest of touches from Barnes. There was some talk from the commentators that Miley was briefly pulled back by Rice, but nobody appealed for a penalty. Replays show a slight touch on the arm.
74 min Hall’s floated corner hits the top of Havertz’s head and loops onto the top of the crossbar! Right now – and I know there’s a long way to go – Arsenal are hanging on to a 2-1 deficit.

73 min For the umpteenth time in the second half, Newcastle win the ball and go straight for the heart of the Arsenal defence. Willock hits a low shot from 25 yards that takes a big deflection, wrongfoots Kepa and bounces well wide.

70 min: Triple substitution for Arsenal Kepa, Myles Lewis-Skelly (No49 ladies and gents) and Christos Tzolis come on for David Raya, Eberechi Eze and Bruno Guimaraes. You can imagine the noise being made by the Newcastle fans as he leaves the field.
69 min Yep, Raya is really struggling and is being helped off the field with his left arm being held tight to his body. Kepa Arrizabalaga is getting ready to replace him.
67 min Raya goes down holding his left shoulder after an innocuous-looking collision with Osula. I say innocuous-looking because you never really know with shoulders.
66 min Newcastle’s second-half performance has been utterly brilliant. It’s hard, in the heat of the moment, to assess whether Arsenal have played badly or just been overwhelmed.
65 min Willock runs on to a deft pass from Osula and hits the side netting from a very tight angle.
64 min: The goal stands! “Wowsers,” says Niall Mullen. “Newcastle were such a shower in the first half I was ready to relegate them. It’s a funny old game Saint.”
63 min: VAR check Hang on, there’s a check for a potential offside/handball/anything.

Newcastle have battered Arsenal since half-time and now they’re in front. Hall swung a deep corner to the bizarrely unmarked Burn, whose header hit a Newcastle player on the line as Gabriel and Raya fell backwards into the net. The ball ran loose and was poked in from a yard by Thiaw. Goodness me.
What a sensational turnaround!
62 min Eze slips while playing a short backpass to Raya, whose attempted clearance his Livramento, dribbles towards goal and is put behind for a corner by Gabriel.

60 min Miley splatters a rising drive from 25 yards. It’s straight at Raya, who pats it down comfortably, but it was beautifully struck with his right foot. Newcastle are all over Arsenal – but they have to score now because otherwise we know how this ends.
58 min Barnes is booked for legging up Ezri Konsa. Newcastle have snapped away at Arsenal since the break.
57 min Barnes floats a dangerous free-kick that is headed away crucially by Havertz. Burn was behind him, six yards out, ready to snap his neck and head past Raya.
56 min Hall is fouled 25 yards from goal by Rice, who is inevitably booked. This match has changed completely.
55 min Since half-time, Newcastle have had 78% possession.
52 min All of a sudden Newcastle fancy this. Willock runs away from Rice on the halfway line and moves to within 25 yards of goal before curling over.
Rice is also limping. Arsenal’s title defence is in tatters.

Newcastle are level! Odegaard tried to play a bouncing ball forward but sliced it behind his back and into the path of Osula. He moved into the area and played an inviting square pass to the onrushing Harvey Barnes, who swept a decisive finish to the right of David Raya.
Who saw that coming?
48 min Raya gets to his feet after a couple of minutes’ treatment. Kepa Arrizabalaga is warming up but it looks as if Raya is fine.
46 min Within 20 seconds of the restart, David Raya dives bravely at the feet of Willock. Good goalkeeping. Raya was caught accidentally on the head by Willock and will need treatment.
Newcastle are making a triple substitution at half-time. Tino Livramento, Anthony Elanga and Jacob Ramsey are on for Jacob Murphy, Sean Steur and Amar Dedic.
Musical interlude
Premier League match reports
Manchester City 1-1 Fulham
Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland
Bournemouth 2-0 Nottm Forest
Chelsea 1-4 Leeds
Coventry 3-2 Crystal Palace
Tottenham 2-0 Ipswich

Eze’s free-kick is punched away by Hornicek, the last action of a first half that ends with boos from the home fans. Arsenal are on course to go eight points clear at the top. They wore Newcastle down during an ultimately one-sided first half, with Kai Havertz and the scorer Eberechi Eze combining for a fine goal. This isn’t news, but Arsenal are a seriously good football team.

45 min: Fine block by Hall! Odegaard gets away on the left and slides an inviting low cross to Madueke, who looks certain to score until Hall gets round to deflect his shot over the bar. Brilliant defending.

43 min: Good save by Hornicek! Madueke robs Hall, who is having a dodgy spell, and sets off towards goal. He gallops into the area, just about keeps his balance and drives a low right-foot shot from the angle that is kicked away by Hornicek.
41 min Barnes has a speculative shot blocked after a decent raid down the left by Osula. That’s the first time in ages that Newcastle have penetrated the final third.
39 min Calafiori cuts inside from the right – don’t ask me, he’s the left-back – and screws a shot well wide.
Gabriel may have an injury problem; he’s feeling his side. William Saliba is among the subs.

38 min “I’m sorry to hear that Charles Antaki’s lobster is too buttery and his diamond shoes are too tight (5.14pm),” writes Matt Dony. “The front three might not be Salah/Mane/Firmino (sob) but they’re doing a job. Whether Kari Tulinius likes it or not, I’d like to congratulate Arsenal on the successful defence of their title. Stick a fork in it. Roll on next season.”

37 min Newcastle will be frustrated that the goal stemmed from an error, and surprised that the man responsible was the usually excellent Lewis Hall. It was a split-second misjudgement that was punished ruthlessly by Havertz and Eze.
35 min “Such prescience,” says Richard Hirst. “What lottery numbers have you picked?”
Pah, that’s an insult! The lottery is pure luck. But there’s nothing lucky about a stopped clock showing the correct time twice a day.

items.titleZh: 纽卡斯尔联 2-2 阿森纳：英超联赛实时战报
items.summaryZh: 马杜埃凯扳平比分，阿森纳客场2比2战平纽卡斯尔联。
bodyZh: 今天的直播就到这里。感谢大家的陪伴，特别是所有温暖人心的邮件，让我感到温暖和一丝感动。晚安！
路易斯·泰勒的比赛报告：纽卡斯尔联 2-2 阿森纳
如果说米克尔·阿尔特塔很高兴看到埃迪·豪离开纽卡斯尔联的主教练岗位，那么坏消息是，圣詹姆斯公园球场又迎来了一位同样难缠的技术区对手。
如果说这位阿森纳主帅过去并不太喜欢客场对阵埃迪·豪的旧部，那么阿尔特塔显然更不喜欢这次泰恩赛德之行。马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒的球队在上半场一度被完全压制，但在下半场凭借出色的表现奋起直追，最终扳平比分。
“这最终是一场精彩的比赛，”克里斯·帕拉凯瓦斯写道，“虽然一场胜利会给PIF和MJ带来巨大的心理鼓舞，但这提醒了主场比赛的必要模板：紧逼对手让他们感到不舒服，快速向前传球，因为吉尔迪人更看重努力和拼搏，而不是纵向足球之类的概念。”
“平局或许是公平的。许多球员都有令人鼓舞的表现。现在他们需要找到一些稳定性。而我需要利用周日剩下的时间去约会或者把GTA VI的进度推到25%。保重兄弟——很高兴你回来！”
不客气，克里斯。很高兴能回来，尤其是能解说这样精彩的比赛。
更新后的英超积分榜
那是令人窒息的下半场，有可能成为马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒执教生涯的转折点。他在中场休息时做出三人换人调整，当时纽卡斯尔联0-1落后且全面处于下风。效果立竿见影，在接下来的半小时里，纽卡斯尔联痛击了英格兰最好的球队。
哈维·巴恩斯扳平比分，马利克·佳夫将比分反超，他们甚至差点取得3-1的领先，随后马杜埃凯为阿森纳攻入扳平进球。精彩的娱乐，美妙的比赛。
……但比赛现在结束了。巴恩斯在终场哨响后被黄牌警告，大概是因为裁判认为他在赖斯的拼抢下假摔。
90+10分钟，巴恩斯认为自己在禁区边缘被赖斯犯规。裁判不这么认为。令人心跳加速的时刻……
90+8分钟，另一端，哲凯赖什在禁区左侧兜射高出。这是一个比拉姆齐更难的机会——角度更小，压力更大。
90+7分钟，巴恩斯将赖斯甩在身后，内切并找到了右侧的拉姆齐。他带到禁区边缘，身体张开……推射高出横梁。啊，这算是一个半机会。球可能有些弹跳。
90+6分钟，巴恩斯在左路颇具威胁地推进，但传中落入了凯帕的怀中。
90+4分钟：阿森纳做出换人调整，擅长绝杀的维克托·哲凯赖什和米克尔·梅里诺换下马丁·厄德高和凯·哈弗茨。
90+2分钟：纽卡斯尔联换人，斯文·博特曼换下有些一瘸一拐的路易斯·霍尔，他在失球时的失误已经是很久以前的事了。
90分钟：好吧，接下来还有九分钟的超长补时。
90分钟，马杜埃凯右侧开出角球，蹭到佳夫的头后弹出了远门柱几码外。天哪，这太紧张了。
87分钟，另一端，拉姆齐抢在廷贝尔（我想是的）之前完成了一次关键解围。
85分钟，下半场替补登场表现出色的拉姆齐在左侧赢得角球。双方似乎都对平局不满意。
84分钟，纽卡斯尔联的任意球导致佳夫的射门被封堵偏出。他本来就越位了，你还在争什么？
83分钟：纽卡斯尔联换人，约安·维萨上，乔·威洛克下。
81分钟，阿森纳本赛季曾在圣詹姆斯公园球场落后逆转绝杀。空气中弥漫着某种历史重演的氛围。
80分钟，伯恩在边线附近对廷贝尔犯规后喋喋不休。马杜埃凯冲上前去与伯恩对峙，这是一个勇敢的举动，差点让伯恩把他掀翻在地。
伯恩和马杜埃凯被黄牌警告。
农伊·马杜埃凯延续了出色的状态，攻入关键进球。这来自一次精彩的反击，毫无意外地由厄德高发起。他将球分给外侧的马杜埃凯，后者内切带入禁区。马杜埃凯假动作晃过两名后卫，在15码处起脚射门，皮球发生折射穿过了霍尔尼切克。
阿森纳凭空扳平比分！
75分钟：纽卡斯尔联的机会，凯帕神勇扑救挡出麦利的脚下球，后者在接巴恩斯精妙触球后杀入禁区。解说员曾提到麦利似乎被赖斯短暂拉拽，但没有人抗议点球。慢镜头显示手臂有轻微接触。
74分钟，霍尔开出飘忽的角球，击中哈弗茨的头顶后弹到横梁顶部！目前——我知道比赛还有很长一段路——阿森纳正艰难维持着1-2的落后。
73分钟，下半场不知第几次，纽卡斯尔联抢断后直插阿森纳防线腹地。威洛克在25码处低射，皮球发生巨大折射，骗过了凯帕，偏出立柱很多。
70分钟：阿森纳做出三人换人调整，凯帕、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利（49号先生女士们）和克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯换下大卫·拉亚、埃贝雷奇·埃泽和布鲁诺·吉马良斯。你可以想象当他离场时纽卡斯尔联球迷制造的噪音。
69分钟，是的，拉亚确实有些撑不住了，左臂紧贴着身体被搀扶离场。凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加正准备替补登场。
67分钟，拉亚在与奥苏拉一次看似无害的碰撞后倒地，捂着左肩膀。我说看似无害是因为肩膀的伤势你永远说不准。
66分钟，纽卡斯尔联下半场的表现简直太出色了。在激烈的比赛中很难评估阿森纳是踢得糟糕还是仅仅被打爆了。
65分钟，威洛克接奥苏拉的精妙传球突入，在极小角度下打中边网。
64分钟：进球有效！“天哪，”尼尔·穆伦说，“纽卡斯尔联上半场表现太烂了，我都准备降级他们了。圣徒球迷，足球真奇妙。”
63分钟：VAR介入，等等，正在检查潜在的越位/手球/任何情况。
纽卡斯尔联自下半场开始以来就压制了阿森纳，现在他们领先了。霍尔开出深远角球找到诡异无人盯防的伯恩，他的头球击中了门线上的纽卡斯尔联球员，加布里埃尔和拉亚双双倒退着摔入网窝。皮球散落，佳夫在距离球门一码处捅射破门。我的天啊。
多么轰动的逆转！
62分钟，埃泽在回传拉亚时滑倒，拉亚试图解围却踢中了利夫拉门托，皮球滚向球门，被加布里埃尔抢先解围出底线。
60分钟，麦利在25码处轰出一脚上旋远射。球正中拉亚下怀，他稳稳把球按住，但这脚右脚抽射确实非常漂亮。纽卡斯尔联全面压制阿森纳——但他们必须进球，否则我们都知道结局会如何。
58分钟，巴恩斯因绊倒埃兹里·孔萨被黄牌警告。下半场开始后，纽卡斯尔联一直对阿森纳穷追不舍。
57分钟，巴恩斯开出危险任意球，被哈弗茨关键头球解围。伯恩就埋伏在他身后六码处，随时准备将球顶进拉亚的大门。
56分钟，霍尔在距离球门25码处被赖斯犯规，赖斯无可避免地吃到黄牌。这场比赛完全变了样。
55分钟，下半场开始以来，纽卡斯尔联的控球率高达78%。
52分钟，纽卡斯尔联突然起势。威洛克在中线摆脱赖斯，带球推进到距离球门25码处后兜射高出。
赖斯也一瘸一拐的。阿森纳的卫冕之路摇摇欲坠。
纽卡斯尔联扳平比分！厄德高试图向前传出弹地球，却将球切到身后并落入奥苏拉脚下。他杀入禁区送出威胁横传，插上的哈维·巴恩斯果断推射破门，皮球飞入大卫·拉亚的右侧。
谁能想到这一点？
48分钟，拉亚经过几分钟的治疗后站了起来。凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加正在热身，但看起来拉亚没事。
46分钟，下半场刚开场20秒，大卫·拉亚神勇倒地扑救化解了威洛克的脚下球。出色的门将表现。拉亚在这次扑救中头部不小心被威洛克撞到，需要接受治疗。
纽卡斯尔联在中场休息时做出三人换人调整。蒂诺·利夫拉门托、安东尼·埃兰加和雅各布·拉姆齐换下雅各布·墨菲、肖恩·施图尔和阿马尔·代迪奇。

埃泽的任意球被霍尔尼切克扑出，这也是上半场的最后一次进攻，半场结束时主场球迷发出了嘘声。阿森纳目前在积分榜上领先优势有望扩大到八分。他们在最终呈一边倒的上半场中逐渐消耗了纽卡斯尔联，凯·哈弗茨和进球功臣埃贝雷奇·埃泽配合攻入了一粒精彩的进球。这虽然不是新闻，但阿森纳确实是一支实力极其强大的球队。
45分钟：霍尔精彩封堵！厄德高在左路摆脱防守，送出威胁低平球到门前，马杜埃凯眼看必进无疑，但霍尔及时赶到将他的射门挡出横梁。出色的防守。
43分钟：霍尔尼切克精彩扑救！马杜埃凯抢断状态糟糕的霍尔后带球杀向球门。他全速冲入禁区，勉强保持平衡并在小角度起右脚低射，被霍尔尼切克用脚挡出。
41分钟，奥苏拉在左路完成一次不错的突袭后，巴恩斯的一脚远射被封堵。这是纽卡斯尔联很久以来第一次攻入对方进攻三区。
39分钟，卡拉菲奥里从右路内切——别问我为什么，他可是左后卫——随后一脚远射偏出很多。
加布里埃尔可能受伤了，他正捂着肋部。威廉·萨利巴在替补席上。
38分钟，“听说查尔斯·安塔基的龙虾黄油太多、钻石鞋太紧（下午5:14），我很难过，”马特·多尼写道，“前场三叉戟可能不是萨拉赫/马内/菲尔米诺（呜咽），但他们正在完成任务。不管卡里·图利纽斯喜欢与否，我要祝贺阿森纳成功卫冕冠军。尘埃落定。期待下个赛季。”
37分钟，纽卡斯尔联一定会对失球源于失误感到沮丧，并惊讶于罪魁祸首竟然是平时表现极佳的路易斯·霍尔。这是一个电光石火间的误判，被哈弗茨和埃泽无情地惩罚了。
35分钟，“多么富有先见之明，”理查德·赫斯特说，“你选了什么彩票号码？”
呸，这是侮辱！彩票纯属运气。但坏掉的时钟一天还能准两次，这可不是靠运气。

bodyEn: If Mikel Arteta was delighted to see the back of Eddie Howe as Newcastle’s head coach, the bad news is that another similarly awkward technical area adversary has been installed at St James’ Park.

Arsenal’s manager never seemed to relish trips to face Howe’s old team and he certainly did not enjoy this latest trip to Tyneside, where Matthias Jaissle’s initially overwhelmed team fought back commendably to earn a point courtesy of a stellar second-half performance. At half-time the crowd had felt close to turning against Jaissle but he held his nerve and, thanks to a triple substitution and subtle tactical rejig suggested he is no mug after all.

It left Arsenal – who lost their outstanding goalkeeper David Raya to a potentially significant second-half shoulder injury – still top of the Premier League, six points clear of Brighton and Manchester City, and Arteta with a face like thunder.

Just last week Bruno Guimarães claimed he was “beloved” by Newcastle fans but the club’s former captain turned Arsenal midfielder found himself serenaded by a soundtrack of boos of the sort usually reserved for Sunderland players. Newcastle’s problem is that, despite spending about £275m this summer, they have struggled to replace last season’s departed star trio – Guimarães, Sandro Tonali and Anthony Gordon.

That reality perhaps left Howe’s successor – who arrived just before the start of the season – making a not so subtle point with his team sheet here. Of Jaissle’s starting XI only the goalkeeper, Lukas Hornicek, the right-back Amar Dedic and the midfielder Sean Steur were close-season signings.

The other five new faces were either benched (Nico González and Matias Fernandez-Pardo) or did not make the 20-man matchday squad (Aladji Bamba and Bazoumana Touré). Admittedly Ewen Jaouen is injured but, given Bamba and Toure cost a combined £78.5m, their omission represented quite a statement. Ditto the decision to bench González and Fernandez-Pardo and their individual £50m plus price tag.

Meanwhile the jury remains out on Hornicek. The Czech international has made some excellent saves this season but, initially here, his kicking proved pretty much uniformly poor and he was fortunate to be reprieved after hesitating too long as the impressive Kai Havertz closed in.

Jaissle’s frustration with his goalkeeper proved well apparent as Arsenal took increasing control of a first half that saw Newcastle’s lone striker, William Osula, isolated and even their normally imperious England left-back Lewis Hall given a thorough work out by Noni Madueke.
Much to Arteta’s chagrin, Lewis Miley, preferred to González in the midfield holding role, endeavoured to slow the tempo but the red tide could only be stemmed for so long.

When Havertz dispossessed Hall after the latter miscontrolled a long ball, he cut inside and slid a highly intelligent, beautifully calibrated, pass across to the on-rushing Eberechi Eze. Without breaking stride, Eze exhibited perfect balance and unleashed a gorgeous first-time shot that arrowed, inexorably, past Hornicek.
• Arsenal ended a 21-game run of Premier League games without a draw (W18 D3) since a 2-2 draw with Wolves back in February.
• Since the start of last season, all five of Newcastle’s Premier League draws at St James’ Park have been a 2-2 scoreline.
• Eberechi Eze’s opener for Arsenal (pictured) was his first Premier League goal since April, which also put the Gunners 1-0 ahead against Newcastle. Opta
As the home fans fell eerily silent, Arteta and his staff celebrated a goal sufficiently special to rebuke suggestions that his side are all about efficiency at the expense of artistry these days.

With Declan Rice always available to reinforce his defence and smother any flickering home attack it proved a struggle to recall Newcastle making a meaningful attacking touch inside Arsenal’s box. Fans stationed near the home dugouts told Jaissle what they thought of it all.

Arsenal’s pressing was initially so good that Newcastle were left almost incapable of playing short passes and, instead found themselves reduced to aimless long balls. With Rice and Martin Ødegaard apparently operating on a different midfield planet an equaliser felt like a distant dream.

Yet that seemingly ambitious vision was something Harvey Barnes proved fully capable of buying into. When, early in the second half, Ødegaard made an uncharacteristic error, his heavy touch sliced the ball in Osula’s direction and the Dane played it into Barnes’s path.
All that remained was for the left winger to take a single, steadying, touch before an assured finish left the hitherto redundant David Raya picking his shot out of the net.

Jaissle’s second-half introduction of Tino Livramento, Jacob Ramsey and Anthony Elanga – all at Newcastle last season – at the expense of Dedic, Steur and Jacob Murphy was paying dividends. Suddenly, almost astonishingly, Arsenal were the team in danger of being pressed into submission.

The home side were closing their guests down far higher up the pitch and had morphed into an infinitely more menacing team. Soon, they were ahead when a Hall corner was headed down by Dan Burn, allowing Malick Thiaw to stab the ball beyond Raya.

Shortly afterwards Arsenal’s goalkeeper was helped off the pitch in evident pain after sustaining a nasty left shoulder injury during an ostensibly benign collision with Osula. On came Kepa Arrizabalaga in a triple substitution also featuring Guimarães’s exit.

Madueke though was still around and he reminded everyone of his presence by meeting the counterattacking Ødegaard’s fine pass, dummying two defenders and watching his slightly deflected shot evade Hornicek’s grasp.

No matter; Jaissle had done enough to win plenty of hearts and minds. Not least the chair, Yasir al-Rumayyan, over from Riyadh to watch his first match of the season and reportedly “take the club’s temperature”.

items.titleZh: 拉亚受伤但马杜埃凯扳平比分，阿森纳客场战平纽卡斯尔
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳门将拉亚肩部受伤，马杜埃凯建功助球队客场战平纽卡斯尔，仍居英超榜首。
bodyZh: 如果米克尔·阿尔特塔很高兴送走埃迪·霍发电纽卡斯尔联队的主教练，那么坏消息是，圣詹姆斯公园球场又迎来了另一位同样难缠的技术区对手。
阿森纳主帅似乎从不乐意前往面对霍夫的老东家，他也绝对不喜欢这次最新的泰恩赛德之旅，马蒂亚斯·雅伊斯勒最初被压制的球队凭借出色的下半场表现奋起反击，值得表扬地扳平比分。半场结束时，现场球迷几乎要对雅伊斯勒失去耐心，但他顶住了压力，通过三次换人和微妙的战术调整，证明他并非无能之辈。
这场平局让阿森纳——他们失去了表现出色的门将大卫·拉亚，后者下半场遭遇了可能很严重的肩部受伤——依然稳居英超积分榜首位，领先布莱顿和曼城6分，而阿尔特塔则脸色阴沉。
就在上周，布鲁诺·吉马良斯声称他深受纽卡斯尔球迷的喜爱，但这位前俱乐部队长转投阿森纳的中场球员，却听到了通常只有桑德兰球员才会享受到的嘘声。纽卡斯尔的问题在于，尽管今年夏天花费了约2.75亿英镑，他们却很难替代上赛季离队的球星三人组——吉马良斯、桑德罗·托纳利和安东尼·戈登。
这种现实或许让霍夫的继任者——在赛季开始前不久上任——在首发名单上做出了一些并不那么含蓄的表态。在雅伊斯勒的首发十一人中，只有门将卢卡斯·霍尔内切克、右后卫阿马尔·代迪奇和中场肖恩·施图尔是休赛期的新援。
其他五名新面孔要么坐在替补席上（尼科·冈萨雷斯和马蒂亚斯·费尔南德斯-帕尔多），要么甚至没有进入20人的比赛日大名单（阿拉吉·班巴和巴祖马纳·图雷）。诚然，尤恩·饶恩受伤了，但考虑到班巴和图雷两人总共花费了7850万英镑，他们的缺席是一个相当大的声明。同样，将冈萨雷斯和费尔南德斯-帕尔多放在替补席上以及他们各自超过5000万英镑的身价也是如此。
与此同时，外界对霍尔内切克的评价仍未定论。这位捷克国脚在同赛季做出了一些极佳的扑救，但在这里一开始，他的开球证明相当糟糕，在令人印象深刻的凯·哈弗茨逼近时他犹豫了太久，可以说是侥幸逃过一劫。
雅伊斯勒对门将的挫败感显而易见，因为阿森纳逐渐控制了上半场，纽卡斯尔的单箭头前锋威廉·奥苏拉被孤立，甚至连他们通常无可挑剔的英格兰左后卫刘易斯·霍尔也被诺尼·马杜埃凯狠狠折腾了一番。
令阿尔特塔懊恼的是，被委以中场防守重任的刘易斯·米利（而非冈萨雷斯）试图放慢节奏，但红色浪潮只能被阻挡一时。
当哈弗茨在霍尔对长传球失控后断球时，他内切并送出了一记极具灵性、精准校准的传球，给插上的埃贝雷奇·埃泽。埃泽在不停球的情况下展现了完美的平衡感，轰出一记精彩的凌空射门，直挂死角，势不可挡地越过了霍尔内切克。
阿森纳结束了自2月份2比2战平狼队以来连续21场英超无平局的走势（18胜3平）。
自上赛季开始以来，纽卡斯尔在圣詹姆斯公园球场的全部五场英超平局都是2比2的比分。
埃贝雷奇·埃泽为阿森纳攻入的进球是他自4月以来的首个英超进球，当时这也帮助枪手1比0领先纽卡斯尔。Opta
随着主场球迷陷入诡异的沉默，阿尔特塔和他的教练组庆祝了一个足够特别的进球，回击了近来关于他的球队只讲究效率而牺牲艺术性的说法。
由于德克兰·赖斯随时准备支援防线并扑灭任何闪烁的主队进攻火花，很难让人回想起纽卡斯尔在阿森纳禁区内有过什么有威胁的触球。坐在主队教练席附近的球迷向雅伊斯勒表达了他们对这一切的看法。
阿森纳的高位逼抢一开始是如此出色，以至于纽卡斯尔几乎无法打出短传，只能被迫开出漫无目的的长传。由于赖斯和马丁·厄德高显然处于不同的中场维度，扳平比分感觉就像是一个遥远的梦想。

然而，哈维·巴恩斯证明自己完全能够接受那种看似雄心勃勃的愿景。比赛刚开场不久，厄德高出现了一次罕见的失误，他的重触将球弹向奥苏拉的方向，这位丹麦球员顺势将球传到了巴恩斯脚下。
剩下的就是这位左边锋稳稳地停球，随后自信的推射，让原本无事可做的大卫·拉亚只能从网窝里捡球。
雅伊斯勒在下半场换上了蒂诺·利夫拉门托、雅各布·拉姆齐和安东尼·埃兰加——上赛季均效力于纽卡斯尔——换下了代迪奇、施图尔和雅各布·墨菲，这收到了成效。突然之间，令人震惊的是，阿森纳反而成了那支面临被压制到崩溃边缘的球队。
主队在更靠前的地方对客队进行逼抢，变成了一支更具威胁的球队。很快，他们就取得了领先，霍尔开出的角球被丹·伯恩头球顶下，马利克·蒂奥将球捅过拉亚。
不久之后，阿森纳门将在与奥苏拉一次看似无害的碰撞中左肩严重受伤，痛苦地被搀扶离场。凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加替补登场，这也是包含吉马良斯离场的三人换人调整的一部分。
不过马杜埃凯依然在场上，他接到了反击中厄德高的精妙传球，晃过两名后卫，射门经轻微折射越过了霍尔内切克的扑救范围，再次向所有人宣告了他的存在。
没关系；雅伊斯勒的表现已经赢得了许多人的心和支持。尤其是从利雅得赶来观看他本赛季第一场比赛并据称“考察俱乐部情况”的主席亚西尔·阿尔-鲁马扬。

bodyEn: Arsenal have suffered a further injury blow after it was revealed that one of their most famous supporters, New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani, tore his achilles while playing in a friendly soccer match on Thursday and is out of action until next summer.

Not long after Mikel Arteta confirmed Bukayo Saka may not return to action before Christmas as he continues rehabilitation from a thigh injury, Mamdani added to Gunners woe by outlining how and why he is also sidelined for some time during a press conference that began with him announcing plans to close the Rikers Island jail complex.

“We [City Hall] played a friendly game against the press corps last night [of] soccer,” said Mamdani on Friday morning, sporting crutches as well as a protective boot that he will require the use of for six to eight weeks. “Which we won 10-5. I scored a goal soon after getting on the pitch and forgot that I was 35. And soon after, I tore my achilles and will play soccer in about nine months.”

The match took place at an indoor pitch near City Hall and, according to reports, Mamdani’s injury was non-contact and occurred while he was running onto a pass. An unfortunate injury but also an avoidable one – as Mamdani, who is only a few months into a four-year contract with the city of New York, revealed in Friday’s press conference, he did not stretch before taking to the field on Thursday night. For Mamdani, it is very much a case now of feet up for the remainder of Arsenal’s season, starting with Saturday’s Premier League visit to Newcastle United.

“It is time to finally close Rikers Island,” Mamdani said in his principal statement on Friday. “For decades, New Yorkers have demanded a correctional system that is safe and humane. This plan puts us on a path to deliver just that: closing Rikers, reducing pretrial detention, tackling the case delays that deprive people of their right to a speedy trial and investing $146m in the evidence-based supports that helps break the cycles of incarceration.”

New York faces a legally mandated deadline to close Rikers by August 2027, a deadline that was established under legislation passed by the city council in 2019 and signed into law by the then mayor, Bill de Blasio.

Mamdani has previously used sport to engage with people held at Rikers Island, visiting the jail complex in July to watch the World Cup semi-final between England and Argentina. A month earlier, the Guardian was granted rare access to Rikers, where nearly 2,000 incarcerated people gathered across the complex to watch the New York Knicks play in their first NBA finals in 27 years.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳遭遇新的伤病打击，佐赫兰·马姆达尼跟腱撕裂将缺阵
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳知名球迷、纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼踢球时跟腱撕裂，将缺阵九个月。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳遭遇又一次伤病打击之际，据透露，他们的知名球迷之一、纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼周四在参加一场足球友谊赛时跟腱撕裂，将缺阵至明年夏天。
就在米克尔·阿尔特塔确认布卡约·萨卡在继续进行大腿伤势康复期间可能无法在圣诞节前复出后不久，马姆达尼在一场新闻发布会上讲述了他受伤的经过和原因，给阿森纳的伤病名单再添愁云。发布会的开场是他宣布了关闭赖克斯岛监狱群的计划。
马姆达尼于周五上午拄着拐杖并穿着防护靴出席，他将在未来六到八周内持续使用这些装备。“我们（市政厅）昨晚与媒体记者踢了一场足球友谊赛，”马姆达尼说道。“我们以10比5赢了。我上场不久后进了一个球，却忘了自己已经35岁了。不久之后，我的跟腱就撕裂了，大约九个月后才能重新踢球。”
这场比赛在市政厅附近的一个室内球场举行。据报道，马姆达尼是在无对抗情况下奔向传球时受伤的。这是一个不幸却本可避免的伤情——正如马姆达尼在周五的新闻发布会上透露的那样，他周四晚上上场前并没有进行拉伸。对于马姆达尼来说，接下来的阿森纳整个赛季他都只能高高架起双脚观看比赛了，首先是周六英超客场对阵纽卡斯尔联的比赛。
“是时候最终关闭赖克斯岛了，”马姆达尼在周五的主旨声明中表示。“几十年来，纽约人一直要求建立一个安全且人道的人口矫正系统。这项计划让我们走上了实现这一目标的道路：关闭赖克斯岛、减少审前羁押、解决剥夺人们接受快捷审判权利的案件拖延问题，并投资1.46亿美元用于基于证据的支持措施，以打破监禁的恶性循环。”
纽约面临着法律规定的2027年8月之前关闭赖克斯岛的最后期限，该期限是根据市议会于2019年通过并由时任市长比尔·德布拉西奥签署成为法律的立法确定的。
马姆达尼此前曾利用体育与关押在赖克斯岛的人员进行互动，他曾于7月访问该监狱群，观看英格兰与阿根廷之间的世界杯半决赛。一个月前，《卫报》获准罕见地进入赖克斯岛，当时近2000名被关押人员聚集在整个监狱群中，观看了纽约尼克斯队27年来的首场NBA总决赛。
